assumptions.rationale: The stakeholder-map complexity is evidenced (Arcloops 2026); the exact authority structure by entity type is not sourced to a study.
assumptions.value: Decisions often involve a sponsor plus procurement and, in family businesses, family stakeholders. The exact authority map varies by entity type (free zone, mainland, government-linked).

evidence.value: Commercial and board language is English-first. Frontline, customer and many merchant contexts require Arabic. English is the primary language of business; Arabic is the official language.

source.name: Shuraa, Why Dubai is Ideal for UK Entrepreneurs; OneCity, Digital Marketing Agency in Dubai (updated 2026-08-31)

evidence.value: Dubai has 40+ free zones (DMCC, DIFC, Dubai Internet City, JAFZA and others). Free-zone companies get 100% foreign ownership but generally cannot sell directly to UAE mainland customers without a distributor or branch. DIFC has its own legal framework based on English common law.

Relationship-building drives buying. Procurement can be elongated, with duplicate pilots across subsidiaries and elongated evaluation. Governance and data-residency checks come early in procurement, not only after an incident.

source.name: Shuraa, Why Dubai is Ideal for UK Entrepreneurs

evidence.value: Corporate tax is capped at 9% and only applies to profits exceeding AED 375,000.

source.name: OrganizerTone, Working in Dubai: A Complete Guide for Global Professionals

evidence.value: The official work week in the UAE is Monday to Friday. Many companies operate Monday to Thursday with a half-day on Friday.
